events.name: The One That Cannot Turn Back
events.intro:
Snow on a ridge. A Mega Absol stands at the edge, wings of white fur shaking. It has been Mega for a week. It cannot stop.

The Absol does not attack. It watches you and makes a sound that is almost a word.
An old woman with a lantern, coming up the path: "You see it too. Good. I thought I was mad."
Old woman: "My son's Absol. He fell on this ridge, battling, with the Key Stone still in his fist."
Old woman: "The bond's open. Nobody on the other end. It can't come back down."
Old woman: "We buried the Stone with him. I didn't know."

success.text: "The churchyard's two hours down," she says. "I'll meet you at the grave. I want to be there."
Old woman: "Break it and he's gone twice." She turns and goes down the path alone, toward the churchyard. You can follow.
You leave it on the ridge. It follows you at a distance for the rest of the region. It does not sleep, so nobody does.

events.name: The One That Cannot Turn Back: The Churchyard
events.intro: The churchyard gate is iced shut. Something has made its den among the old stones, and it does not want visitors.

success.text: It comes out of the snow at you.

events.name: The One That Cannot Turn Back: The Grave
events.intro:
The old woman kneels and lets you dig. The Stone is in your hand. The Absol lands beside the grave.

Old woman: "Someone has to hold the other end."
Old woman: "I'm too old. His girl's too young. But she wants to."

success.text: The bond closes through you. The Absol reverts, sleeps for a full day, and when it wakes it comes with you. It needs no Stone of its own: the bond is already there.

effects.text: An Absol that had been Mega for a week came back down, through you.

success.text: The girl, Mirel, holds it two-handed. The Absol reverts and goes home with her. The old woman presses her lantern into your hands. "It shows the weather on the road ahead," she says. "He made it."
The Stone cracks in two. The Absol reverts, free, and runs into the snow. You see it once more, on a far ridge, looking back.

events.name: The Stone Harvest
events.intro:
Red uniforms on a hillside. A seam of stone glows under their drills. Somewhere down the valley, a Pokémon screams.

Flare Grunt: "Stand aside. This is a licensed excavation."
Grunt: "Every stone we cut is worth a house. Every stone."
Down the valley, a Mega Ampharos staggers through a field, its mane flickering on and off.
Farmer, running up: "That's mine! It just went off like that! Is that you? Is that you lot?"
Grunt: "We cut a stone, something somewhere evolves. Not our problem."

success.text: You note the mine's entrance. It will take more than one day.
Grunt: "Forty. Maybe fifty." He holds one out, low, where the farmer can't see. "Yours. Look the other way."

You leave the mine and go down to the field. You stand with the Ampharos for two turns of its flickering, talking, until its mane goes dark and it sits down in the grass. The farmer will not forget it.
The drills keep running behind you.

events.name: The Stone Harvest: The Offer
events.intro: One random Mega Stone, now, for looking the other way. The farmer is still standing there.

success.text: You take it. The farmer saw you take it.
"Your loss." He pockets it. You go round the mine and mark the entrance.

events.name: The Stone Harvest: The Mine
events.intro: The mine. Three levels down, two Flare checkpoints, and at the bottom, the seam chamber.

success.text: Flare Grunt: "You again? Get them!"

events.name: The Stone Harvest: The Second Checkpoint
events.intro: The second checkpoint. The walls glow here.

success.text: Two of them this time.

events.name: The Stone Harvest: The Seam Chamber
events.intro:
Celosia, Flare Admin: "You found us. The boss said someone would."
Celosia: "Do you know what a Mega Stone is? It's a Pokémon's future, frozen. We're just thawing them early."
Her Mega Manectric has been Mega for three days. Its fur is falling out.

choices.label: Return the stones to the ground.

success.text: Celosia: "Then you'll have to make me."

win.text: The stones went back into the seam. Celosia's Manectric reverted, and she held it, stunned.

choices.label: Give back the bribe, then return the stones.

success.text: Celosia: "You took one. You're no different." You put it on the ground between you. She looks at it for a long time.
Celosia: "So that's what you came for."
No battle. You open the old drainage gate and the river comes in. The seam is gone for the run, and so is every Mega Stone in this region. The meter goes still.

events.name: The Twin Flames
events.intro:
Two Charizard in a clearing, each Mega in a different way: one black with blue fire, one sleek with wide wings. Then both drop, gasping, back to normal.

Teen trainer, Brann: "They're siblings. Hatched the same day. One Charizardite between them, so I broke it in half."
Brann: "They each get two turns now. Then they collapse."
Brann: "I know. I know. It was stupid."
His sister, Ketty, arriving: "It was your idea. Don't make it sound like you're sorry now."

success.text: Brann: "There's a stone-cutter. In the hills." Two nodes to her.
Ketty: "Don't you dare." Brann and Ketty command one sibling each.
Win or lose, they will leave without fixing it.

events.name: The Twin Flames: The Stone-Cutter
events.intro:
The stone-cutter is a past Gym Leader, retired, half-blind.

Stone-cutter: "Two halves. I can make one whole stone now. Or two whole stones, given two years and the rest of my sight."
Stone-cutter: "I'd do the two. But that's me."

success.text: One sibling becomes a full Mega, black and blue-fired. The other leaves the clearing for good.
One sibling becomes a full Mega, sleek and wide-winged. The other leaves the clearing for good.
"Two years," she says. "Come back when you're further along."
They fight it out in an exhibition you referee. The winner chooses its own Mega, and comes with you.

events.name: The Twin Flames: Both Whole
events.intro: A letter finds you on the road, and then the twins themselves: both Charizard, both whole. The stone-cutter did the two.

success.text: Brann and Ketty argue about it for an hour. In the end one sibling simply walks over to you and sits down.

events.name: The Twin Flames: The Other Sibling
events.intro: A wild Charizard on a burnt hillside, wings scorched, angry. An Alpha now. It is the sibling that left the clearing, and it wants its sibling, not a fight.

success.text: It comes at you anyway.

choices.label: Let your Charizard go to it.

success.text: Your Charizard walks up to it alone. They stand nose to nose a long time. The red goes out of its eyes, and it follows you both.

events.name: The Mirror-Spider
events.intro:
An old ruin under a hill. In one room, a Metagross made of old pale stone stands still. In the next, the same shape: dark, legged like a spider, clicking.

Neither moves when you look at it. When you turn, the clicking moves.
An archaeologist, Teodor, in the doorway: "Don't turn your back. I'm serious."
Teodor: "It's one Pokémon. Mega Evolved across a time rift. Half of it's here, half of it's there."
Teodor: "I've been watching them six weeks. They want to be in the same room."

success.text: Teodor hands you a mirror from his kit. "Each moves only when it's unseen. Let each see where the other stands."
The pale one turns to face you. It is not still any more.
Teodor keeps watching. The ruin stays on the hill.

events.name: The Mirror-Spider: Room 1
events.intro: The first room. The pale form stands by the door. Somewhere ahead, clicking.

choices.label: Set the mirror so each can see the other.

success.text: You angle the mirror and back away. Behind you, the clicking moves one room closer.

choices.label: Turn your back to draw it on.

success.text: You turn. It is right behind you. You do not turn again until your heart stops pounding.

events.name: The Mirror-Spider: Room 2
events.intro: The second room has three doors. The dark form is in the far one, very still, as long as you look at it.

choices.label: Set the mirror so each can see the other.

success.text: You angle the mirror and back away. Behind you, the clicking moves one room closer.

choices.label: Turn your back to draw it on.

success.text: You turn. It is right behind you. You do not turn again until your heart stops pounding.

events.name: The Mirror-Spider: Room 3
events.intro: The third room is all mirrors already: someone tried this before. One is cracked.

choices.label: Set the mirror so each can see the other.

success.text: You angle the mirror and back away. Behind you, the clicking moves one room closer.

choices.label: Turn your back to draw it on.

success.text: You turn. It is right behind you. You do not turn again until your heart stops pounding.

events.name: The Mirror-Spider: The Central Room
events.intro:
Both are in the central room. They face each other.

Teodor, whispering: "It's going to choose."

success.text: The rift closes like an eye. On the floor: one Metagross, normal, asleep. It joins you. Either Delta form will answer it, when it Mega Evolves.
You step between them. The Spider form fades into the rift. The Ruin form stays, and comes to you, unstable. Teodor is furious.

events.name: The Three Tatsugiri
events.intro:
A beach under a light rain of fish. A Dondozo sits on the sand with its mouth wide, looking miserable. Inside it, three small voices argue.

Fisher: "It's been like that since dawn. It ate something."
Three Tatsugiri poke out: a Curly, a Droopy, and a Stretchy. Each glows. Each pushes the others back in.
Fisher: "Is that... are they all trying to Mega?"
The Dondozo hiccups. More fish fall.

success.text: Three rounds: a rhythm, a trick with a Berry, a dive. You judge.
They bite. The Dondozo gets angry.
A Big Malasada goes in. The Dondozo burps them out, dazed, onto the sand.
Five Berries go in, one after another. The Dondozo burps them out, dazed, onto the sand.

events.name: The Three Tatsugiri: The Verdict
events.intro: The Curly pouts. The Droopy lies flat. The Stretchy waits.

success.text: The Curly Megas once, proudly, and the others sulk. The Droopy climbs out of the Dondozo and comes with you, still sulking. It will prove a point one day.
The Droopy Megas once, proudly, and the others sulk. The Stretchy climbs out of the Dondozo and comes with you, still sulking. It will prove a point one day.
The Stretchy Megas once, proudly, and the others sulk. The Curly climbs out of the Dondozo and comes with you, still sulking. It will prove a point one day.
None Megas. They make up. All three climb back into the Dondozo and ride off. One shouts back, and you notice a fourth seat left in its mouth.

events.name: The Three Tatsugiri: A Ride
events.intro: A Dondozo surfaces by the shore with its mouth open. Three small voices shout from inside. There is a seat for you.

success.text: You cross the sea in a Dondozo's mouth, three nodes in one long, wet, cheerful ride.
They shout something rude and very fond, and swim away.

events.name: The Flower That Was Never Meant to Bloom
events.intro:
A field of yellow flowers. In the middle, a Floette with a red flower, glowing, Mega Evolved. It should not be possible.

It flies straight to you and hides behind you.
Across the field, the grass is burning in a perfect line, coming from the east.
A Ranger, arriving: "There's a lab out east. It's pulling power from somewhere. Every flower for a mile's wilting."
Ranger: "That Floette came from that direction. Running."

success.text: Three nodes east along the burnt line.
It stays with you, under your coat. The meter climbs while the lab runs. You will have to find it sooner or later.
Nurse Joy can't treat it. Joy: "It's not hurt. It's frightened." You go east after all.

events.name: The Flower That Was Never Meant to Bloom: The Fence
events.intro: A Flare scientist at the lab fence, with a clipboard and a Pokémon that has clearly been told to guard it.

success.text: "Visitors are not on the schedule."

events.name: The Flower That Was Never Meant to Bloom: The Reactor Room
events.intro:
Flare scientist: "It's charging. It's been charging for three thousand years. Do you know what it was built to do?"
The Floette stares at the machine. It starts to shake.

success.text: A battle at the console.
It flies into the machine and out again. The reactor dies. The Floette reverts, but its flower is pale.

events.name: The Flower That Was Never Meant to Bloom: North
events.intro: The Floette slumps into your hands, then lifts its head and points north. Toward a tall shape on a road: a very old, very tall man, walking.

success.text: He sees it and stops walking. He kneels. The Floette flies to him and he cups it in both hands, and you understand that it was always his. He gives you the last thing he made before the war.

effects.text: The old man gave you the last thing he made before the war: AZ's Flute.

success.text: He sees its pale flower and weeps. He holds it a long time. Then he gives you the last thing he made before the war.

effects.text: The old man gave you the last thing he made before the war: AZ's Flute.

events.name: Mega Without a Stone
events.intro:
A rival battle, mid-fight. {rival}'s ace is down to its last hits. Then it glows. No Key Stone. No Mega Stone. It Megas anyway.

{rival}: "{say event||bitter-challenger::WHAT. What did... did you do that? Did I do that?||champion-chaser::WHAT. What did... did you do that? Did I do that?||strategist::That's impossible. That's not in any paper.||protector::Stop! Stop the fight! Is it hurting?||idealist::Stop! Stop the fight! Is it hurting?||prodigy::...Okay, I'm going to pretend I meant that.||enthusiast::...Okay, I'm going to pretend I meant that.}"

success.text: You finish it. The glow does not.
You put your hand up. {rival} has already run onto the field.

events.name: Mega Without a Stone: Is It Hurt?
events.intro:
The battle ends. The ace drops back to normal and lies down in the grass, breathing hard.

{rival}: "I don't... it's never done that. Is it hurt?"

success.text: {rival} nods too many times. "Okay. Okay. Together."

branches.text: {rival}: "It WAS amazing, wasn't it?" They brighten all at once.
{rival}: "...Yeah. Maybe." They do not look at you.

success.text: {rival}: "...Yeah. Maybe."
{rival} goes alone. For two stages the Rival Report has them at the lab, sleeping in a chair beside their ace.

events.name: Mega Without a Stone: Three Readings
events.intro: A research errand. You and {rival} take a borrowed meter to three points around the region: a cliff, a lake, a stone circle. At each one the needle swings further than the last.

choices.label: Take the readings to the Professor.

branches.text: The meter is very high; the needle sits against the pin. The region is close to something. {rival}'s bond with their ace did the rest.

success.text: The meter is high: the whole region is humming. And {rival}'s bond with their ace did the rest.

events.name: Mega Without a Stone: The Finding

remembers.notice: Professor: "The meter has been falling since that mine was shut. Whatever they choose matters a little less than it would have."

events.intro:
Professor: "I can seal it. Or not. It's theirs to decide."

{rival}: "What do you think?"

success.text: The Professor seals it. {rival} breathes out, and presses their spare Key Stone into your hand. "You keep this one. I don't need it now."
{rival} keeps it. Their ace will Mega without a stone in every battle against you from now on. It is stronger. It is also dangerous.

branches.text: {rival} does not even hesitate. "Seal it. It was hurting." Afterwards they press their spare Key Stone into your hand.
{rival}: "Keep it. Obviously keep it." Their ace will Mega without a stone in every battle against you now.
{rival} looks at you, and at their ace, and decides to trust the Professor. They seal it, and give you their spare Key Stone.

success.text: {rival} thinks about it for a long time. Then they keep it.

events.name: Mega Without a Stone: At the Lab
events.intro: Two stages later, a letter from {rival}, from the lab. They decided on their own.

branches.text: "We sealed it. It was hurting." There is a spare Key Stone folded into the letter.
"We sealed it. The Professor showed me the numbers." There is a spare Key Stone folded into the letter.

success.text: "We kept it. I know. Don't say anything." Their ace will Mega without a stone in every battle against you now.

events.name: Mega Without a Stone: Out of Control
events.intro:
The meter is at five. {rival}'s ace Megas before the battle has even started, and it does not stop. It does not know them.

{rival}: "Help me. Please. We have to calm it down together."

success.text: You and {rival} stand side by side and hold it until the glow goes out.

win.text: You and your rival calmed their ace when its stoneless Mega ran out of control.

success.text: {rival} does it alone. It takes a long time, and they do not look at you afterwards.
